payload.author: coordinator
evidence: A fresh read-only mapping trace sees LIBCMT, LIBCPMT and system import libraries that an openat-only descendant trace did not observe. Symbol inspection of mapped files identifies the expected common requests in heapinit.obj and sbheap.obj, but the function-oriented Coff reader refuses import-object and import-descriptor members. This is evidence for a compiler-boundary input inventory plus native COFF/import-record support, not proof of complete input coverage or selected allocation sizes.
payload.hypothesis: Common-allocation admission needs a complete, fingerprinted compiler/link-input inventory, including implicit libraries and both regular COFF and import-object records. Do not infer input absence from child openat traces, or reuse the function COMDAT verifier as a complete symbol-inventory reader. Keep unsupported inputs visible until the native inventory can classify them safely.
